test_title: PYST 21: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The fall of Ranjith for the petty material benefit was really __ignominious__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Reprehensible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• The word "**ignominious**" means shameful or disgraceful. (शर्मनाक या अपमानजनक)

 
 
• **Example**: *The defeat was so ignominious that the team struggled to recover their morale.*
